messages.snippet: Hi Accounts, WC-00199 (Meridian Signal Analytics – Harcourt Beverages MSSA) has now completed. Pleas
messages.subject: WC-00199 Meridian/Harcourt – please raise final invoice
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Accounts,

WC-00199 (Meridian Signal Analytics – Harcourt Beverages MSSA) has now completed. Please raise the final invoice to Meridian (Henry Calderwood, CFO). Total recorded time comes to £33,400 plus VAT, within the £28–38k estimate. Narrative: drafting and negotiation of MSSA, Order Form, SOW, SLA and DPA through to execution on 3 November 2025.

Thanks,
Donna Bridges | PA to Sarah Whitfield

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
